geometry: 14 x 14 canvas with a translucent black, slightly rounded background and a translucent white, square-ended saw waveform drawn with straight segments. The waveform spans approximately x=2 to 12 and y=2 to 11 with a 1.4-unit stroke.
limitations: The smooth diagonals and sharp stroke edges approximate the antialiased, softly rendered original. Native and 8x SVG renders were visually inspected.
